x-semantics: Exact13 parent fields. Root depth0; each value and object key a node; no array-index nodes; keys at parent+1. Whole canonical UTF8 bytes include punctuation and escaping
All old six children and steel snapshot retain exact independent frozen validators and policies; parent does not relax any child and does not fabricate old release
Existing children objectId equal parent INTERNAL objectId and manifest hash; KR060 child.objectId equals parent PUBLIC objectApiId, manifest equal normal manifest. KR060 snapshot binds both IDs

Lease internal objectId/inputManifestHash and release/provider/attempt/fence must equal protected parent; JobLease sourceDecisions has metadata not decisionId/contentHash: compare only available fields, full review pointers bound by authenticated child

Strict builtin-only safeint/Unicode scalar/native descriptor-first zero callbacks, dense arrays/no proxies/getters/cycles; ASCII object keys at outer boundary (existing nested v3/T82 schemas already fixed ASCII keys)

Enforce full byte/node/depth caps before DTO/selection; strict bounded HTTP decoder rejects duplicates/nonfinite/unsafe numeric fields, 64MiB response and 60second deadline; no auto fallback/custom budget
All retained children validated before worker text downloads/execution. Protected endpoint dedicated explicit v12 only, v6 route untouched

Snapshot/header/authenticated DB entry equality and journal/source/artifact/PDF fingerprints rechecked under inspection lock before start; entire immutable package used at completion and historical replay
